term: founded by God through an envoy; agency vocabulary (Confirms, HoldsMandate, FoundedInMandate, CommissionedToTeach)
definition: God founds a society through Jesus as envoy when Jesus founds it in the exercise of a mandate from God (FoundedInMandate jesus g c) and commissions it to teach (CommissionedToTeach jesus c). Holding a mandate is the separate relation HoldsMandate x g (x speaks and acts with authority received from g); STMT-ENVOY-FOUNDING-IS-GODS-FOUNDING does not require it, FoundedInMandate does not by itself entail it, and that jesus is not identified with g is the intended reading only: distinctness is not encoded. The same record defines the Agency vocabulary used by all four premises. Confirms g p is g's confirming the proposition p by a sign that is g's own deed: a testimonial act, not a mere display of power, and not by itself the truth of p. In this sense FoundedAsTeachingAuthority g c, the root's primitive, is satisfied by founding through an envoy as well as by immediate founding. All four agency relations are uninterpreted parameters of the Agency structure; only the premises STMT-RESURRECTION-CONFIRMS-JESUS-MANDATE, STMT-GOD-CONFIRMS-ONLY-TRUTH, STMT-MANDATE-COVERS-JESUS-FOUNDING-WITH-TEACHING and STMT-ENVOY-FOUNDING-IS-GODS-FOUNDING constrain them.
note: Stipulative modelling choice for #357, not a sourced reading. Dei Filius ch. 3 para. 5 (Deus per Filium suum ... Ecclesiam instituit) is compatible with both senses: on the council's theology the Son is God, so his act also fits immediate founding. The envoy sense is chosen because the skeleton's Signature does not identify jesus with any being satisfying IsGod, so Jesus' founding can count as God's only through a premise relating them. A sourced definition would need a source analysing mission and representation, e.g. Lumen gentium III §§18-20 (already pinned) or Aquinas on mission.
